A terrestrial '''astronomical object''' was home to a [[Unidentified farm village|farm village]] and [[Mon-Hella]] during the [[Imperial Era]]. Former [[Jedi]] [[Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano]] hid on the astronomical object for a [[time]] after surviving [[Order 66]], until her presence was reported to the [[Galactic Empire]].<ref name="Resolve" />
